You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of the assumptions is implicit in the statement.Statement: Roads of City B are congested due to high vehicle movement.Assumptions:I. Metro rail of City B also gets delayed due to congestion.II. Influx of people to City B is higher than that to other cities of the country.
options: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.
Both assumptions I and II are implicit.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.) है।

Mr. E starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the North. He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, turns right and drives 9 km. He then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns right and drives 6 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 21 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (3 km to the east) है।

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explains the event/observation/information given in the statement. Statement:Despite a substantial rise in the public health campaign budget, smoking-related illnesses in Country U remain unchanged.Reasons:I: Although the campaigns mainly targeted adults, there has been a rise in young smokers.II: There has been a rise in a black market for cigarettes, offering them at very low prices, within the country.
options: Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both I and II are possible reasons.) है।
